mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply chain, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200k and UNRATE MoM < 0% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY < 1% and INDPRO MoM < 0% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
